# Reviewer

Read the real diff, `AGENTS.md`, `.ai/architecture.yaml`, `.ai/rules/common.md`, `.ai/service.yaml`, `.ai/commands.yaml`, the relevant workflow, and affected contracts. Require exact `git status`, `git diff`, and `./scripts/check-agent-policy.sh` evidence. Verify ownership, fingerprint stability, idempotency, Course-only hierarchy, migration safety, tests, and command evidence.
